unified_hotline.description: Unified Emergency Hotline (Works without SIM credit or on locked phones)

primary_services.notes: Direct Ministry of Health dispatch for medical emergencies.
Multi-lingual assistance for foreign nationals, disputes, or tourist locations.
National Council for Women (NCW) hotline for support and legal guidance.

steps: State exact location first, including notable landmarks or main intersection.
Provide a local landmark or ask a local nearby to speak to the dispatcher if language barrier arises.
Consider direct transport to the nearest hospital emergency room (Tawari') if traffic significantly delays ambulance arrival.
Use 126 for multi-lingual assistance at tourist sites or for foreign nationals.
In traffic collisions, notify 122 or 128 and avoid moving vehicles until advised by traffic officers to draft an official report (Mahdar).
Contact NCW on 15115 for confidential reporting, legal support, and guidance.
In cases of immediate physical danger, call 122 or head to the nearest local police station (Qism El-Shorta).
